title: Provider capability sheet
description: One per provider (capabilities/<provider>.json). The adapter refuses a job the sheet rules out; the director writes in the sheet's syntax; the UI shows a control only when the routed provider's sheet allows it. Facts come from docs/production-tool/providers.md.

checked.description: When the facts were last checked against the provider's docs.

ops.description: Which ops this provider can run, and with which model. An op missing here is unsupported.

estimateUsd.description: Cost of one job at our default settings, for the reserved amount. null when the provider does not publish a price.

durationsS.description: Allowed durations when the model takes only fixed values.

regionModel.description: clip_edit only: the model used when the edit carries a region (when it differs from the feel-edit model).

tagSyntax.description: How a prompt names references: at_tag '@hero' (Runway), at_image_n '@Image1'/'@Element1' (Kling on fal), picture_n '<Picture 1>' (HeyGen), figure_n 'Figure 1' (Seedream), image_n 'image 1' (Qwen), none (refs by order only).

maxCharacter.description: Slots for character references (Runway subject human: 5).

element.description: Takes the character as one element: a front image plus 1-3 angle images (Kling).

mask.description: none: region edits go by the box drawn on a copy of the image plus our paste-back. Otherwise a PNG mask the size of the image, with the given colour marking the area to change.

angles.description: Turnaround by exact camera angle rather than by prompt.

series.description: Storyboard frames one call can return; 0 means one frame per call.

firstFrameWithRefs.description: Can pin the storyboard frame as the first frame AND pass the character views in the same call.

audioDefault.description: The provider's default. Adapters always set audio explicitly anyway.

outputUrlTtlH.description: How long provider output URLs live; null when undocumented. We copy every output to S3 regardless.
